title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up of pressure ulcer.

HPI
Pt is an 83 y.o. female presenting for scheduled wound care. Pt reports the pressure ulcer over the sacrum has remained stable over the past week. She denies any new drainage or increased pain. Pt continues to use a pressure-redistribution mattress at home.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
Gen: Alert, oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Skin: Pressure ulcer noted over the sacrum. Wound is unstageable as the base is covered by eschar. No surrounding erythema or purulent drainage noted.
Vitals: BP 132/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Pressure ulcer, unstageable.

Plan
1. Continue current wound care regimen.
2. Cleanse wound with normal saline.
3. Apply hydrogel dressing to the pressure ulcer.
4. Maintain frequent repositioning every 2 hours.
5. F/u in 2 weeks for wound check.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the sacral region, unstageable (base covered by eschar or slough): L89.150 (HCC 381).

distractors.why: Unstageable is a documented stage (L89.--0), not 'unspecified'.
Do not assign a stage the provider could not determine.

hccs.label: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Full Thickness Skin Loss
